name: Polyart
author: Addicting Games
description: Polyart is a free puzzle game. Beauty truly is in the eye of the beholder, but what if your eye was sliced, shredded, and shattered beyond all recognition? How then would you be able to parse the beauty all around us? Polyart is a game that poses the question and provides the answer. In Polyart you will untangle the mystery of a series of polyart puzzles which have been fractured, divided, shattered into a million-piece puzzle with no this and no that. Do you have the skills required to untangle this mess? Slide the fragments here and there, too and fro, back and forth in order to view the fractals from the correct angle and see the full picture. This is a game about trial and error and instinct. Hone your ability to unravel a mystery and slide these beautiful pictures into view using nothing more than the tips of your fingers and the full breadth and depth of your brain. Polyart is a game that will challenge you on levels that you didn't even know were possible. Enjoy this game alone or challenge a friend to beat your record.
